name: clip-move-unkeyed
description: An edit not keyed yet moves with the body instead of being dropped. One key at frame 0 (root offset 0). On frame 10 the root is set to (0.5, 0, 0) hip heights and not keyed. Sliding 1 m along +X adds 1 / 0.8698308 = 1.1496488 hip heights: the shown root offset becomes (1.6496488, 0, 0), and the key on frame 0 becomes (1.1496488, 0, 0), seen by going back to frame 0 (which drops the unkeyed edit, as moving frames always does). Physics off.
